name: Hit points: roll, keep the better
author: Alexandria
summary: When you level up, roll your Hit Die and take the roll or the average, whichever is higher.

rules.text: When you gain a level, **roll your Hit Die** and add your Constitution modifier. If the roll is lower than the **average** (d6: 4, d8: 5, d10: 6, d12: 7), take the average instead.

assistant.player: When they level up at this table: roll the Hit Die, and if the roll is under the average (d6 4, d8 5, d10 6, d12 7) take the average, then add the Constitution modifier.
assistant.dm: Level-up HP here: roll the Hit Die and keep the higher of the roll and the average, plus Constitution.
